subject: Literature
title: Ernest Hemingway's Lonely Prize
description: A quick win: understand Ernest Hemingway's Lonely Prize.

hook.text: Hemingway won the Nobel in 1954 but was too injured from two plane crashes in Africa to attend the ceremony.

buildup.text: He was honored for The Old Man and the Sea and his influence on twentieth-century narrative style.

discovery.text: Hemingway stripped prose to its bones, proving that simplicity of language can carry enormous emotional weight.

twist.text: Despite his macho public image, Hemingway suffered from depression and took his own life seven years after winning.

climax.text: His Nobel validated a style that influenced every writer who tried to say more by writing less.

punchline.text: The master of simple words carried the heaviest burdens.

quiz.question: Why couldn't Hemingway attend his Nobel ceremony?
options: He was boycotting the Swedish Academy
He was recovering from two plane crashes in Africa
He was on a fishing expedition and refused to return
